name: Mantle of Order
body:
School evocation [lawful]; Level antipaladin 3, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot-radius centered on you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You radiate an aura imbued with order and mechanical precision out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional computational ability to strike with greater accuracy against agents of chaos.

While in the aura’s radius, whenever an ally (including yourself) misses on an attack roll against a chaotic-aligned enemy within the aura, the next attack roll they make against that enemy gains a +2 sacred (or profane, if the ally is evil). This bonus is cumulative if the ally continues misses hitting that enemy. Once the ally has succeeded in hitting an enemy, the bonus from this spell is reset to 0 against that enemy.

If an enemy is instead a chaotic-aligned fey or outsider or if they have the chaos subtype, the bonus provided by mantle of order is increased to +4 instead.
